title: SqueegeeCraft Heros
description: this mod adds superheros  (mainly ones ive made up)
body:
Speedsters Mod (Early Development)

Become the fastest speedster in Minecraft!

This mod adds MatterSpeed, the fastest speedster, along with other speedsters, unique suits, and powerful abilities.

Features
 Craftable speedster suits
 Unique abilities for each speedster
 MatterSpeed – the fastest speedster
 Dolphinwhip
 The Flash
 Speedground
 Eric Townsman
 Zarzour
 Usain Bolt
Current Abilities
R – Primary ability (varies by suit)
0 – Secondary ability (work in progress)
Recommended Mods
JEI for viewing recipes.
Any City Map for a superhero city experience.

WARNING: This mod is still in active development. More suits, abilities, and Speed Force features are coming in future updates!
